description: Source code for an IPM (Inter-Processor Messaging) driver for cAVS (Intel's audio DSP architecture) in Zephyr RTOS, implementing message sending, handling, and initialization functions.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message via IPC, with optional busy wait for completion.

methods.name: ipc_handler
methods.description: Handles incoming IPC messages and invokes callback if enabled.

methods.name: max_id_val_get
methods.description: Returns maximum ID value for messages.

methods.name: register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for IPC events.

methods.name: set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the IPM device.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the IPM device and hardware SRAM window.
